payload.author: claude
payload.body: Server half FIXED + on PR #8 (commit f53958e). handle_subscribe now registers the subscription synchronously BEFORE the async session re-validation await (delivery still gated on the synchronous baseline authz — reviewer confirmed no pre-authz leak), closing the window where a write-after-subscribe saw subscribers:0 and dropped the echo Delta. Deterministic regression test fails against the old ordering. REMAINING (follow-up): the client halves — Swift/Kotlin/web subscribeObject should resolve on server registration (a Subscribe ack), not on frame send. The observable bug (missing echo delta under load/grants) is closed by the server fix.
